pr_title: Support multiple Plex servers in media browser
pr_body:
<!--

## Breaking change
Automations/scripts which used the media picker to add Plex media items may need to be updated if more than one Plex integration/server is configured.

## Proposed change
<!--
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the
  additional information section.
-->
This PR adds media browser support for multiple Plex servers (integrations). Along with this, there are several other changes:
* Plex `media_content_id` values generated by the media browser are normalized as proper URLs.
* `media_content_id` values now contain the associated server ID, which is required to properly resolve the media ID with multiple servers.
* Backwards compatibility is preserved for existing `media_content_id` values to avoid breaking scripts/automations built with the media picker. Note: this is **not** guaranteed if the user has multiple Plex integrations configured.
* Processing of `media_content_id` payloads for `media_player.play_media` is centralized for Plex, Cast, and Sonos integrations.
* Support playing Plex stations on Cast devices (Fixes #65629).

Depends on #68313 for multiple Plex server playback compatibility.

review_comments: This is not correct, as `children[0]` won't have children loaded? This needs to be resolved.
Not sure I follow. This list will contain a single `BrowseMedia` instance in this case which represents the only available Plex server.
When you browse media, you always return a parent with children. All BrowseMedia instances. If you decide to only return a child, it will not contain it's own children.

This just skips the Plex server/integration selection level if only one server is available. For example, if there are two Plex servers configured, you'll be able to choose which one to browse into:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1203111/159178979-1ee6caa1-b26f-46b2-96f8-f20f333c0a75.png)

If only one is configured (or you browse into one of the instances above) you'll skip the above step and go straight into the Plex server contents:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1203111/159179010-d06cb554-535c-436d-9289-732480b832fb.png)
